title: 186. Sqrt(x)

examples.explanation: The square root of 8 is 2.82842..., rounded down to 2.

hints: Binary-search the answer in [0, x]: for mid, compare mid with x / mid instead of mid * mid to avoid overflow.
When mid <= x / mid, mid is feasible and the answer is at least mid; otherwise it is smaller.
Handle x = 0 and x = 1 as direct answers.
